frames.title: Pickaxe raised
frames.description: Front-left, beside low isolated ore-rich rock fragment. Two-handed pickaxe held high ready to strike, helmet and red tunic unchanged.

frames.title: Pickaxe contact
frames.description: Same front-left and rock fragment. Pickaxe tip contacting rock at bottom of swing, feet planted, no blur.

frames.title: Load ore cart
frames.description: Right-side, using a shovel to load broken ore into a short open wooden ore cart with two visible wheels.

frames.title: Sort iron ore
frames.description: Front-right, standing behind a low timber ore sorting bench, separating reddish iron-rich rocks from pale waste by hand.

frames.title: Carry ore buckets
frames.description: Rear-left three-quarter, carrying a filled wooden ore bucket in each hand, full body and both buckets visible.

frames.title: Check timber support
frames.description: Front-left, crouching and examining a timber mine support joint with small mallet held low, isolated short timber assembly only.

note: Character and work props are composed together. These six scenes are independent static references, not an animation loop.
